statement_en: Let\[H(n)=\min_f \max_{X\subseteq \{1,\ldots,n\}} \left\lvert \sum_{x\neq y\in X} f(x,y)\right\rvert,\]where $f$ ranges over all functions $f:X^2\to \{-1,1\}$. Estimate $H(n)$.
statement_lean:
open Filter Asymptotics

def imbalance (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) (X : Finset ℕ) : ℤ :=
  |∑ x ∈ X, ∑ y ∈ X.filter (fun y => x < y), f x y|

noncomputable def H (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf {m | ∃ f : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ, (∀ x y, f x y = 1 ∨ f x y = -1) ∧
    ∀ X ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 n, imbalance f X ≤ (m : ℤ)}

theorem erdos_42041 :
    (fun n => (H n : ℝ)) =Θ[atTop]
      fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  sorry
